first_gate: Seed 5901's four matched algorithms acquire independently to 2048 unless a registered scientific or technical failure closes that identity. Preserve each incomplete denominator. The sealed action and first-parameter real-direction checks remain separate.
subsequent: Evaluate Diff-full using closed training originals at the common node only, excluding heldout. Advance when the registered direction check passed, accepted policy steps are nonzero, both real A and B have achieved the task, and the training campaigns have no added physical hard failure relative to the qualified B3 cases. Each other arm owns the same target budget independently. At a failed Diff-full decision, N_s is its last closed eligible common node; partial/failing arms stay partial.
remaining_seeds: Open 5902 and 5903 when 5901 initial Diff-full node permits escalation. Do not spend a larger budget to compensate for a weaker comparator.
heldout: Freeze the chosen checkpoint, WM, recipe and N_s per seed before seeing any heldout outcome. Each fully frozen new head must pass both own A and B original E30 then E60 before its four heldout mechanism episodes.
long: Display seed 5901, per-case. Require own E60, both full mechanism windows in that case and at least one actual target exposure in each. Compare measured moving positive mechanical CoT and 5kHz moving contact-point slip/m to that case's B3 original E60. Do not extend when both costs deteriorate. E300 then E600 only on own original pass.
fallback: When finite candidate ranking and action execution remain credible but path gradients fail, use the standalone real-PPO fallback under the unspent PPO-full slots/seed. First run seed 5901 to 2048. Alone it does not define a matched four-arm N_s. Continue available model-free acquisition to registered 4096/8192 nodes using the same physics/first-update criterion and report its learning claims separately.
fallback_base: If the P3 rank is usable, keep that frozen P3; if it is not, true PPO may use the separately qualified B3 nominal base, absolute three-dimensional action and causal state. At least one non-hard-failure signed request must have a measured within-state real action consequence above nominal replay. Keep all opportunities in the denominator. Never use model gradients or charge the same head twice.
